a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. The storm risk is high, so let's both operate every round and not waste any. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and I'll respond. I won't take early.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.
